en: A colorized vintage postcard showing a broad, quiet street lined with early 20th-century residential buildings. There are a few people walking on the sidewalk and a single bare tree in the foreground. The building on the left corner exhibits traditional German half-timbered architectural elements. The street view vanishes into the distance, emphasizing the scale of the neighborhood.
